SYSTEM=Mn3Al

#Relax
 #IBRION=2
 #NSW=200
 #ISIF=7
  
Startparameter for this Run:
  ICHARG=1
  ISPIN=2                                    #spin polarized calculation
  LORBIT=11                                  #for band structure, set to 12
  LWAVE=.F.                                  #write wavefunctions to file
  NCORE=8
  ISYM=-1

Electronic Relaxation
  EDIFF=1E-7                                 #stopping-criterion for ELM
  NELM=400
  NELMIN=8
  PREC = Accurate                            #accurate ground state calculation
  LREAL = .FALSE.                            #accurate ground state calculation

#Spin-orbit coupling
  LSORBIT=.FALSE.                            #switches on spin-orbit coupling
  LASPH= .TRUE.                              #include non-spherical contributions in PAW-GGA
  SAXIS=0 0 1                                #Quantization axis used to rotate all spins
  MAGMOM=1.4 1.4 -2.8 0
  GGA_COMPAT=.FALSE.

DOS related values:
  ENCUT=600
  ISMEAR=-5
  SIGMA=0.05
  NEDOS=2001

Mixer
  AMIX      = 0.01
  BMIX      = 0.00001

#with wannier90
 #LWANNIER90=.TRUE.
  LMAXMIX=4
  NBANDS=48
